author: Hunted Cow Games
title: Hiring 2D artists for sci-fi strategy game assets
content: [PAID] Looking for 2D artists for commander portraits, game icons and UI for an unannounced sci-fi strategy game. Hunted Cow Games (huntedcow.com) is looking for freelance artists for an unannounced sci-fi strategy game on Steam and mobile. We need about 30 commander portraits (initially) and a lot of icons, covering skills, currencies, items and more. We're also looking for a UI artist to design the game's interface skin: frames, buttons, panels, HUD and faction branding. The style is polished, semi-realistic digital painting: clean industrial sci-fi, cool metals, cyan glows and dark space tones. No AI art of any kind. Work that uses AI will be rejected, and we'll ask for WIP or layered files. To apply, please email outsourcing@huntedcow.com with your portfolio, what you're interested in, your rates and your availability.
